title: The Lost One's Mark
text: Scratched deep and hasty into a stone at head height are your House's mark and an arrow. The scratches are rusty with old blood. Someone you are looking for passed this way hurt, yet still stopped to leave this for you.

options.label: Follow the bloody arrow, as they hoped you would.

outcomes.text: The marks go on, each fresher than the last.

options.label: The sharpest reads the stone for more, in case they left a warning.

outcomes.text: Beneath the first mark is a second: a warning about what follows them.

options.label: Call out their name, hoping they are still near enough to hear.

outcomes.text: An answer comes from far off. It is weak, but it is theirs.
Something else answers in their voice.
